findings.title: Native Int39 add/sub silently saturate instead of reporting overflow
findings.impact: Compiled add/sub returns saturated values (H, -H) with exit status 0 while the documented core contract, the interpreter and the differential suites require an overflow error. Programs observe different answers depending on backend.
findings.fix: Delete clamp64/clamp_integer_64 and restore checked i128 arithmetic (or explicit overflow branch) for Add/Sub.

findings.title: Failed RISC-V cross-compilation is replaced by a fixed assembly stub and reported as success
findings.impact: With a host Clang that lacks the RISC-V target (or any backend failure), the driver writes `li a0,0; ret` and exits 0. The resulting object/assembly does not implement the program.
findings.fix: Remove the fallback: propagate the tool return code and delete/configurable behaviour must not synthesize code.

findings.title: Arithmetic benchmark encodes clamped values as the expected semantics
findings.impact: Once C-01 exists, the benchmark accepts the wrong semantics, so CI cannot distinguish a clamp regression from correct overflow reporting.
findings.fix: Benchmark the checked path (error) and measure the non-overflow fast path only.
findings.repair_state: upstream-only file; not present in this tree

findings.title: Compiled native loops have no execution budget while the reference executor does
findings.impact: The interpreter bounds work with ResourceLimit; emitted code has no equivalent guard, so an AOT program with a large/looping counter runs unbounded. Documented as a resource limit only for the interpreter.
findings.fix: Document that AOT images are unbudgeted, or emit an opt-in tick guard for loop back-edges.

findings.title: ThreadPool caller-thread exception leaves queued tasks using a destroyed latch (stack-use-after-scope)
findings.impact: If the caller-chunk callback throws, parallel_for unwinds while worker tasks still hold `&sync_latch`; ASan reports stack-use-after-scope at std::latch::count_down.
findings.fix: Catch the caller-chunk exception, always count down/wait for all chunks, then rethrow.

findings.title: ThreadPool worker exception calls std::terminate
findings.impact: Any exception escaping a parallel_for/parallel_reduce body in a worker terminates the process instead of reaching the caller.
findings.fix: Wrap worker tasks in a guard that records std::exception_ptr, counts down, and rethrows on the dispatching thread.

findings.title: Concurrent Kokkos initialize/reinit can SIGSEGV
findings.impact: Concurrent initialization from several threads races on workers/lifecycle state (double join / use of a torn vector) and crashes.
findings.fix: Serialize init/reinit/shutdown under one recursive lifecycle mutex; keep enqueue/shutdown races from stranding tasks.

findings.title: DualRailPlanes capacity arithmetic wraps, publishing huge num_words with a tiny allocation
findings.impact: allocate(SIZE_MAX) computes `(words+7)&~7` and `2*bytes` with wrap-around; ASan reports a heap-buffer-overflow WRITE in set_word.
findings.fix: Reject word counts whose capacity rounding or double-rail byte count overflows size_t.

findings.title: mem::allocate_aligned rounds an oversized byte count with wrap-around
findings.impact: allocate_aligned(SIZE_MAX-31) returns a 64-byte block for a request near SIZE_MAX; callers that trust the requested size write out of bounds.
findings.fix: Validate alignment and reject bytes > SIZE_MAX-(alignment-1).

findings.title: Base243Arena typed allocation multiplies count*sizeof(T) without an overflow check
findings.impact: allocate<T>(count) wraps to a small block for huge counts.
findings.fix: Check count > SIZE_MAX/sizeof(T) and reject; also validate alignment and chunk-size arithmetic.

findings.title: Public noexcept accessors use assert-only bounds checks; NDEBUG reads/writes out of bounds
findings.impact: Under NDEBUG an out-of-range index is an out-of-bounds read (or write in set) rather than a diagnosable error; get_sign(100) segfaults.
findings.fix: Unconditional bounds checks that report std::out_of_range; remove noexcept from checked accessors.

findings.title: parallel_gemm validates shapes only with assert
findings.impact: A dimension mismatch in a release build indexes out of bounds instead of failing the call.
findings.fix: Throw std::invalid_argument on shape mismatch.

findings.title: Legacy Python FFI loads libbt_runtime from the current working directory
findings.impact: `import bt_ffi` executes a shared object planted in the process CWD (library preloading / code execution).
findings.fix: Remove os.getcwd() from the search path; only explicit env var, package-relative, system paths.

findings.title: Legacy Python FFI cannot validate C buffer lengths; mismatched arrays read out of bounds
findings.impact: row_ptr/signs/x/weight lengths are unchecked (some only by assert, removed under -O), so the runtime indexes past ctypes buffers.
findings.fix: Explicit ValueError checks for lengths, monotonicity, and index bounds.

findings.title: Child processes inherit unrelated parent file descriptors on Linux
findings.impact: posix_spawn close-on-exec is only requested under POSIX_SPAWN_CLOEXEC_DEFAULT (not defined by glibc); a compiler child inherits readable/writable descriptors.
findings.fix: Enumerate /proc/self/fd and add close actions for every descriptor > 2.

findings.title: macOS SDK path selection differs between host command and native JIT
findings.impact: Driver prefers SDKROOT while the native JIT prefers a hardcoded path, so the two can compile against different SDKs.
findings.fix: Share one platform_toolchain_flags() helper.

findings.title: xbt_sgemm_unmodified underflows tiny products to zero
findings.impact: 1x1 1e-22 * 1e-22 returns 0 instead of ~9.8e-45 because the two block scales are multiplied in float.
findings.fix: Multiply block scales and accumulate in binary64.

findings.title: xbt_sgemm_unmodified returns NaN on exact cancellation of large values
findings.impact: [1e38,1e38]·[1e38,-1e38] yields NaN instead of 0: per-row float accumulation hits inf + -inf.
findings.fix: Accumulate in double and convert once at the end.

findings.title: xbt_rmsnorm overflows to infinity for subnormal input with eps = 0
findings.impact: 1/sqrt(mean) exceeds FLT_MAX and is narrowed to float before multiplication, giving inf; 0/0 input gives NaN.
findings.fix: Keep the reciprocal in double, handle mean_sq == 0 explicitly.

findings.title: TriRadixScalar::to_double returns NaN on exact large-factor cancellation
findings.impact: 2^-2000 * 5^800 is exactly representable (~1.3e-43) but ldexp/pow underflow/overflow separately and produce NaN.
findings.fix: Renormalize after each factor step and apply a single scalbn.

findings.title: Activation functions return NaN for negative infinity
findings.impact: SiLU(-inf) and GELU(-inf) evaluate -inf * 0; mathematically the limit is 0.
findings.fix: Special-case non-finite inputs.

findings.title: xbt_exp_btfp32 is noexcept but can throw, causing std::terminate
findings.impact: Overflowing a BTFP32 (x = 1000) calls from_double(inf) which throws inside a noexcept function: abort instead of a catchable error.
findings.fix: Remove noexcept and document the domain_error.

findings.title: Two named 'complete' Rocq theorems are literally True and used as terminal proof markers
findings.impact: Proof checking passes while the two 'complete' obligations assert nothing; the checker only looks for the marker name.
findings.fix: Replace with substantive statements over the model and reject vacuous True/0=0 theorem statements in the checker.

findings.title: Hardware 'co-simulation' tests only search source strings
findings.impact: The SystemVerilog check asserts module names exist; the C++ model is never compared against simulated RTL, and the test output claimed co-simulation.
findings.fix: Rename to source inventory, lint with Verilator when present, and state that co-simulation is pending.

findings.title: Latest CI is failing and the failure is reproduced by the overflow regressions
findings.impact: All three compiler jobs fail at 'Build and test'; locally Core_Backend_Regression, Core_Optimized_Differential and Phase1_LLVM_Differential fail on the clamp expectations.
findings.fix: Repair C-01/C-02 (or revert the clamp), then rerun CI.
findings.repair_state: local cause fixed; CI rerun pending

findings.title: Vulkan shader/execution tests are skipped in CI; glslang/spirv-val are not installed
findings.impact: Both Vulkan tests return 77 in CI and locally; GPU paths are not executed by CI at all.
findings.fix: Install glslang-tools and spirv-tools in CI; keep device execution optional.

findings.title: Arithmetic speedup and numerical claims are not reproduced exactly; benchmark scope is narrow
findings.impact: The wide benchmark measures 12.7x/17.1x locally vs 18.37x/40.13x recorded; microbenchmarks do not cover end-to-end compiler work.
findings.fix: Report ranges and hardware, separate micro from end-to-end, keep assertions on operations not timings.

findings.title: C ABI activation entry points do not validate null x/out for nonzero n
findings.impact: xbt_rmsnorm/xbt_softmax dereference null buffers; the C ABI otherwise validates pointers.
findings.fix: Throw invalid_argument when n != 0 and x/out is null.

findings.title: TCSR get() silently returns zero for the builder's open row until finalize()
findings.impact: Elements appended to the row the builder is currently filling are invisible to get() until finalize() (row_ptr[r+1] is still 0).
findings.fix: Treat the open row's end offset as the live nnz.

findings.title: Map admission uses a static statement count, not executed loop iterations
findings.impact: The aggregate work estimate admits batches whose loops multiply the real cost; the interpreter has a per-invocation budget but no aggregate cap.
findings.fix: Enforce an aggregate execution budget across the batch (implemented) and document that admission is heuristic.
